capabilities: Render Markdown notes to standalone HTML pages
Build multi-page folder sites with breadcrumbs and searchable, filterable lists from frontmatter
Share links and QR codes and log every publication in a journal note
Delete expired publications from the bucket on startup
disambiguation: Not a sync plugin; it publishes one-way copies of notes as public web pages that expire after a chosen TTL.
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installed via BRAT or by manually copying files. Published pages may load KaTeX from a public CDN in the viewer's browser.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share notes or folders as self-hosted web pages that automatically expire.

relations.evidence: The plugin talks directly to your bucket (AWS SigV4, signed in‑app) — just like Remotely Save.

requires.name: S3-compatible bucket (Yandex Cloud Object Storage, AWS S3, etc.)

summary: Publishes notes and folders as temporary (TTL) static websites on your own S3-compatible bucket, with images, filtering, QR codes and a link journal.
